assets.subject: wooden-yarn dock/platform with brown posts
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a fresh individual high-resolution transparent PNG cutout for the Seaside Corner layered collection scene in the Pourlune puzzle game. The three input images are STYLE AND CAMERA REFERENCES ONLY: original approved UI boards and the existing knitted beach/water base. Create ONLY the requested independent object, never reproduce a whole UI, never crop or upscale a thumbnail. Match their detailed soft chunky knitted/crocheted yarn miniature 3D style, cream, lavender and blue/white maritime palette, isometric three-quarter camera looking slightly down, soft light from upper left. Object centered and completely visible with comfortable transparent margins, silhouette fills most of its own square canvas, fine visible stitch texture. The entire backdrop must be genuine alpha transparency, including all spaces between posts/leaves/rope. No opaque ground, floor, water, beach, sky, backdrop, UI, text, logos, numbers or watermark. No extra props beyond the requested subject. Preserve complete edges. ONE wooden-yarn dock / pier platform ONLY: a short warm brown rectangular planked dock with sturdy brown corner posts and small rope detailing, viewed isometrically so the top and front/right edges are visible. Posts and support legs are part of the single platform. No beach hut, canopy, plant, lifering, bird, ocean or base.

alpha.note: Generated object cores mostly alpha252/253, preserved raw; no alpha hardening performed.
